notes.title: Tuition moved to 24 November
notes.text: Marie Rose has moved your instalment to 24 November, two weeks on, after you sent her the visa update. That is a firm date rather than an open offer, so the board carries it now. - She asked to be kept posted on the visa, which is what the extension rests on.
acted: Pay EUR 53,000 tuition instalment: 5 November -> 24 November
Put the 24 November deadline in your Google Calendar
